heroHeadline: Israel Strikes Beirut Suburb and Issues Mass Evacuation of Nabatieh as Lebanon-Israel Pentagon Talks Open
heroSubtitle: Israeli forces struck Choueifat neighborhood near Beirut airport (May 28), killed 12 in Mashghara/Bekaa Valley and crossed the Litani River (May 26); UN recorded 670 projectile movements on May 27 — highest since April ceasefire; Lebanese and Israeli military delegations met at Pentagon for first military-track talks on withdrawal and Hezbollah disarmament; 3,200+ killed since March 2
footerNote: Data sourced from UN UNIFIL, World Bank, IMF, Special Tribunal for Lebanon, HRW, Amnesty International, L'Orient Le Jour, Reuters, Al Jazeera, Lebanese Ministry of Public Health, UN Security Council Report, IOM, and scholarly consensus from UNESCO, Oxford, and Cambridge. Ancient history based on archaeological and textual evidence with noted uncertainties.
